notes: Dropdowns where you pick a value show an up-and-down arrow.
Text fields and dropdowns look calmer in Dark mode.
Press Enter while editing a to-do to start a new one right below it. Its ⋯ menu can add a to-do below or a sub-to-do too.
Live view settings open in a big window: pick a font and size, bold, text color, outline and background color.
Choose what sits between groups in the live view (nothing, a line or the group name) and whether finished to-dos show, ticked and struck through.
Patch notes for this module start with this version.
